meta.parties: Podimenika Et Al. v. Anthony Appuhamy

rules.statement: Unless the language of the deed leads unambiguously to the conclusion that a donee who purchases a share from a co-donee must leave it to his lawful children, the alienee takes that share free from any restrictions.
rules.supporting_quote: "I am unable to say that there is any such provision in P1. It seems to me that the only provision the donee has made in P1 is that if the donees die without acting upon the power given to them the property shall devolve on their lawful children, 1 would accordingly dismiss the appeal with costs."
